macro: Unweighted mean over all taxonomy concepts, including zero-support concepts; unresolved decisions excluded before confusion counting.
micro: Sum TP/FP/FN/TN across resolved posting-concept decisions before calculating ratios.
thresholds: Start at no predictions, then all distinct observed scores descending; score >= threshold; ties enter together.
averagePrecision: Sum (recall_i - recall_previous) * precision_i at each observed score threshold. No interpolation. Null if no positive support.
prAuc: Not reported: average precision is the supported ranking summary.
comparison: Differences across regenerated reference sets are descriptive; sample/reference changes prevent attributing a delta solely to rule changes.
